name: ddd-flow
description: The DDD modelling loop as skills: one orchestrator (/ddd-flow:design) reads repo state, decides the next step and invokes it, eight step skills own the workshops, and /ddd-flow:view renders the whole model live in the browser. Episodic by design — greenfield projects and DDD migrations. Hands off to swe-flow through docs/domain/; authors drafts, never flips a status.
